I am looking for the first 10 testers for this free tutorial-to-skill proof pack.

Please comment with:

1. Environment: OpenClaw, Codex, Claude Code, or other.
2. OS: macOS, Linux, Windows, VPS, or container.
3. Install result: did both skills appear in the skill list?
4. Runtime result: did one of the sample prompts produce the expected sections?
5. Failure text or screenshot if anything broke.
6. One public tutorial URL you would want converted next, if any.

Useful commands:

```bash
openclaw --version
openclaw skills info
```

This is a free MVP. Paid packaging is intentionally blocked until there are real install/use results.
